24/S0.subgoal: Explain how novice, intermittent, and expert user categorization can guide interactive-system design without always requiring field studies.

24/S1.subgoal: Explain how a software developer can incorporate user characteristics through different design perspectives and a user-aware development lifecycle.

24/S2.subgoal: Explain the ISO definition of usability, its three crucial aspects, and its three measures: effectiveness, efficiency, and satisfaction.

24/S3.subgoal: Explain user-centered design and related terms that involve users in the design lifecycle.

24/S4.subgoal: Explain how XR systems are interactive systems and why input interaction design and output perception design require user-centered design.

24/S5.subgoal: Summarize the lecture, preview upcoming human factors topics, provide further references, and close the lecture.
